idea-plugin.name: Protocol Blueprint Light
idea-plugin.description:
Protocol Blueprint Light is a complete light theme inspired by engineering blueprints: near-white paper, cobalt-blue controls, fine borders, and softly tinted tool windows. Built on Islands Light, it styles the IDE interface as well as the editor.

  • Distinct green keywords, amber strings and numbers, purple methods, blue types, and slate comments.
  • Readable Git Blame author and date annotations, including the latest commit.
  • Editor and console presets: Fantasque Sans Mono, size 13, line spacing 1.2, and ligatures. Install the font separately; existing font overrides take precedence.

Requires an IDE with Islands Light (build 253 or newer). Select Protocol Blueprint Light under Appearance, and Protocol Blueprint Light 1.1 under Editor / Color Scheme.

Source code and the companion VS Code theme: GitHub. Licensed under MIT.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.1.0: clearer syntax categories and declaration emphasis; corrected Git Blame foregrounds and added five light-blue annotation background anchors. Fantasque Sans Mono 13 and line spacing 1.2 presets.
